behavior: Native modal dialog covers the application viewport; underlying canvas stays inert.
Wheel zoom is anchored to the pointer, from 0.1x to 8x the initial fitted image.
Pointer dragging pans the image directly; release/cancel clears dragging.
Escape and the close button exit with the shared 200ms ease-out animation.
Canvas viewport, image positions and selection are unchanged; reopening resets the image view.
Responsive initial fit keeps portrait/landscape images uncropped on smaller screens.
